description: Larak Island, Hormozgan province, Iran. US strike on two IRGC rocket launchers. CENTCOM stated it took 'limited, precise action' against forces preparing to launch rockets carrying sea mines into the Strait of Hormuz. Tasnim reported three IRGC personnel killed; the IRGC statement referred to fighters and civilians killed and wounded. Timestamp derived from reporting of 'shortly before 3am Dubai time' on Monday 31 August (UTC+4); treat as +/-1 h, not an instrumental origin time. Position is the island centroid; Larak is roughly 5 km across, which is the stated uncertainty. VALIDATION VALUE: FIRMS VIIRS coverage was present on 29 Aug - 2 Sep with 188-313 detections elsewhere in the region, and zero within 0.1 deg of this position. This is a known strike with confirmed satellite coverage and no thermal detection - a measured point on the detection floor, not an absence of event (REQ-8.6).

description: Saudi-owned oil tanker Sidr (Bahri) struck by three projectiles while exiting the Strait of Hormuz. Attribution and casualties are carried as source-attributed statements only (REQ-11.5).
